αἱματόεις: αἱματόεις — bloody, blood-stained (αἷμα + -όεις); masc. nom. sg., last in its clause
αὐλὸν: αὐλός — pipe, tube, socket (which tube is meant is not certain); masc. acc. sg., after παρά
βεβάμεν: βαίνω — step, go; perf. stand, be planted; perf. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic βεβηκέναι): ’to stand (over)’
γήρασκε: γηράσκω — grow old; impf. 3 sg., inchoative -σκ-, unaugmented (= ἐγήρασκε): ’was growing old’
δεύετο: δεύω — wet, drench; impf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐδεύετο): ’was drenched’
δησάμενος: δέω — bind, tie; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having bound (on for himself)’
εἰρύσσαισθε: ἐρύομαι (εἰρύομαι) — protect, guard, keep safe; aor. opt. mid. 2 pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐρύσαισθε); with ἄν, potential: ’could you protect’
εἰσαναβῆναι: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. inf. act. (root aor. ἀνέβην): ’to go up into’
εὔκηλοι: εὔκηλος — at ease, undisturbed (by-form of ἕκηλος); masc. nom. pl.
κατέχοντο: κατέχω — hold down, hold fast; impf. 3 pl. pass., unaugmented (= κατείχοντο): ’were held’, with ἠέρι of means
κηρύσσων: κηρύσσω — proclaim as a herald, be a herald; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’as herald, heralding’
κλειτῷ: κλειτός — famous, renowned (epic by-form of κλυτός); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with a place-name
κυδαλίμω: κυδάλιμος — glorious, renowned (from κῦδος); masc. nom. dual, agreeing with ἀνέρε
λαρίσης: Λάρισα — Larisa, a town; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἀπό
λειώκριτον: Λειώκριτος — Leiocritus, son of Arisbas and companion of Lycomedes; masc. acc. sg.
λυκομήδεος: Λυκομήδης — Lycomedes, a Greek leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
λύοντο: λύω — loose, unfasten; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’were loosing (for themselves)’, of stripping armour
μέμνηντο: μιμνήσκω (μέμνημαι) — remind; perf. mid. be mindful; plpf. 3 pl., sense of an impf., unaugmented (= ἐμέμνηντο): ’were mindful’, + inf.
μεταπαυόμενοι: μεταπαύομαι — pause between, rest in turn; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’pausing in between’
νεκροὶ: νεκρός — dead (man), corpse; masc. nom. pl.: ’the dead’
πέπτατο: πετάννυμι — spread out; plpf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐπέπτατο): ’was spread abroad’
παιονίης: Παιονίη — Paeonia, the land of the Paeonians; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἐκ
πανοπῆϊ: Πανοπεύς — Panopeus, a Phocian town; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
πελασαίατο: πελάζω — bring near; aor. opt. mid. 3 pl., epic -αίατο (= Attic -αιντο), in a wish: ’let them bring’
πεποιθότας: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust, rely on; perf. part. act. masc. acc. pl., + dat.: ’trusting in’
πεπύσθην: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear; plpf. 3 dual of πέπυσμαι, unaugmented (= ἐπεπύσθην): ’the two had learned’
περίφαντι: Περίφας — Periphas, a herald; masc. dat. sg. (stem Περιφαντ-), with ἐοικώς: ’like Periphas’
περιβάντα: περιβαίνω — go round, bestride; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg. (root aor. -βην): ’bestriding’, + dat.
πλήθεΐ: πλῆθος — multitude, great number; neut. dat. sg. πλήθεϊ with diaeresis (= Attic πλήθει): dat. after verbs of trust, ’in (their) numbers’
πληγεῖσ: πλήσσω — strike; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (πληγεῖσ’ = πληγεῖσα): ’struck’
πορφυρέῳ: πορφύρεος — purple, dark red; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πορφυροῦ), agreeing with a neut. noun
σάκεσσι: σάκος — shield; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σφετέρῳ: σφέτερος — their own; possessive of the 3 pl.; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun
τείροντο: τείρω — wear down, distress; impf. 3 pl. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτείροντο): ’were worn down’
τρεῖτ: τρέω — tremble, flee in fear; pres. 2 pl., elided (τρεῖτ’ = τρεῖτε): ’you tremble’
φθίνυθον: φθινύθω — waste away, perish; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφθίνυθον; Attic φθίνω): ’were perishing’
φόρκυνα: Φόρκυς — Phorcys, a Phrygian captain; masc. acc. sg., epic -υνα (= Attic Φόρκυν)
χάζεσθαι: χάζομαι — give ground, draw back; pres. inf. mid., after ἀνώγει: ’to give ground’
ἀγχιστῖνοι: ἀγχιστῖνος — close together, one upon another (sense inferred from ἄγχι); masc. nom. pl., epic
ἀκωκῇ: ἀκωκή — point, tip (of a spear); fem. dat. sg.
ἀλεείνοντες: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun (epic by-form of ἀλέομαι); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’shunning’
ἀνέδραμεν: ἀνατρέχω — run up; strong aor. 3 sg. (stem δραμ-), ν-movable: ’ran up’
ἀνέσχε: ἀνέχω — hold up; intrans. stand out; strong aor. 3 sg. (stem σχ-, ἔσχον): ’stood out’
ἀναιμωτί: ἀναιμωτί — without bloodshed; adv. (ἀ- privative + αἷμα)
ἀντίλοχός: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, a young Greek warrior; masc. nom. sg., apposition to φῶτε
ἀρίσβαντος: Ἀρίσβας — Arisbas, father of Leiocritus; masc. gen. sg. (stem Ἀρισβαντ-)
ἀστεροπαῖος: Ἀστεροπαῖος — Asteropaeus, a Paeonian ally of the Trojans; masc. nom. sg.
ἀφεσταότες: ἀφίστημι — set apart; perf. stand apart; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic -αότες (= Attic ἀφεστῶτες): ’standing apart’
ἄκρη: ἄκρος — topmost, at the tip; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ἄκρα): ’the topmost’
ἐπιοσσομένω: ἐπιόσσομαι — foresee, forebode; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. dual: ’the two foreboding’, + acc.
ἐπιτάρροθον: ἐπιτάρροθος — helper, ally (a rare word; the formation is obscure); masc. acc. sg., predicate of an accusative subject with εἶναι
ἑκατηβόλον: ἑκατηβόλος — far-shooting, epithet of Apollo; masc. acc. sg., epic
ἔρχατο: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, pen; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο ending (Attic uses a periphrasis, εἰργμένοι ἦσαν): ’were penned’
ἔχοντο: ἔχω — hold; mid./pass. be held; impf. 3 pl. pass., unaugmented (= εἴχοντο): ’were held (out)’
ἕκτόρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg.: ’Hector!’
ἠπυτίδῃ: Ἠπυτίδης — son of Epytus (patronymic); masc. dat. sg., in apposition to a dat. noun
ἤρικε: ἐρείκω — split, tear; strong aor. 3 sg. act. (ἤρικον), intrans.: ’split, burst’
ἱπποδάσεια: ἱπποδασύς — thick with horsehair; fem. nom. sg. ἱπποδάσεια, agreeing with κόρυς
ἱπποθόῳ: Ἱππόθοος — Hippothous, a Pelasgian leader; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -όῳ (= Attic -ῳ), after περιβάντα
ὀξεῖα: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun
ὑπερδέα: ὑπερδεής — fearless (ὑπέρ + δέος ’fear’; the formation and sense are disputed); masc. acc. sg., contracted from ὑπερδεέα (Attic ὑπερδεῆ)

__broaden__.ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κῦδος: ’boundless’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond measure, boundlessly’
__broaden__.ἀρηΐφιλος: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus · also masc. nom. sg., epithet of Lycomedes
__broaden__.εἶχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., augmented (contracted from ἔ-εχε): ’had, held (as wife)’ · also ’kept, maintained’ (ἀλαοσκοπιὴν εἶχε ’kept a careless watch’) · also impf. 3 sg. absolute, with a negative: ’could hold on, could hold out’
__broaden__.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι) · also indefinite τις, written τίς before the enclitic φησι: ’someone’
__broaden__.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’) · also adv. ’right through’ before πρό (διὰ πρό) · also adv. before ἀμπερές: ’through, right through’
__broaden__.ὁμάδῳ: ὅμαδος — din, uproar, noise of a crowd; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a roar’ · also masc. dat. sg. after ἐνί, of place: ’in the uproar’
__broaden__.ἱεμένων: ἵεμαι — hasten, press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’hastening’ · also with περ: ’though eager’
__broaden__.ἔφαντο: φημί — say; mid. ’think, suppose’; impf. mid. 3 pl. (= Attic ἔφασαν), + fut. inf.: ’they said, they supposed (he would …)’ · also impf. mid. 3 pl. + acc. and pres. inf.: ’they supposed (him to be) …’
__broaden__.αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic αὐτοῦ): ’him’, after πάροιθε ’before him’ · also masc. gen. sg., object of τιτύσκετο: ’at him’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἄγχι: ’close to him’
__broaden__.ἠέρι: ἀήρ — mist, haze; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέρι, of means: ’in mist’ · also masc. dat. sg., of cause, with a second dative: ’from mist’
